description: Creates or updates an account's cloud patrol: keywords (1 to 10; a "#tag" entry searches a topic tag), reply persona, daily_cap (1 to 50 on free and trial, up to 80 on paid plans, up to 150 with a haixun add-on), enabled, and review_before_reply. When patrol is on, the account replies to relevant fresh Threads posts through the official API every 15 minutes, one patrol point per delivered reply; with review_before_reply:true every drafted reply waits in list_pending_replies instead of going out. Turning patrol on, or changing a patrol that is already on, needs the patrol permission, which is not granted to directory connections: the owner does it in MindThread. Applies when the user wants to stop patrol or tune its keywords, persona and cap while it is off.

daily_cap.description: reply: 1-50 free/trial, up to 80 paid, up to 150 with add-on; discover: 1 to plan daily haixun points (default)

mode.description: "reply" (default): AI drafts and posts replies. "discover": only list matching posts for you to read; no AI, nothing posted

reply_max.description: Max characters per reply, 20-200, or null for the language default. A persona asking for a length is followed up to this limit

reply_mode.description: "ai" (default): AI writes each reply in the persona. "rotate": post your fixed replies in order, word for word, starting over after the last (AI still decides which posts to reply to). "consume": like rotate but each reply is used once; patrol stops for the account when all are used. Fixed replies come from rotate_replies or the imported library (import_cloud_patrol_replies)

rotate_replies.description: 1-10 fixed replies used in order when reply_mode is "rotate"; each within the account reply length limit; changing them restarts from the first

name: set_cloud_patrol
title: Set cloud patrol
